label: A profile is admissible exactly when no member requires the lack of members
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the constitutive reading of the admissible intrinsic profile family. A set of real determinations is admissible exactly when it is exclusion-free: no member d and subset S of the set are such that d requires the lack of S. Every incompatibility in the family is then grounded in what some member requires. It is neutral about purity; it denies irreducibly holistic incompatibilities, joint prohibitions that no member's requirement accounts for. It does not identify the primitive family with the defined notion; it states that they coincide.
